raw_log: Caused by: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
fix_solution:
If you have a Metaspace error, you'll need to increase the "Metaspace Heap Size" field on the "Java Settings" page of your NodePanel. It's also the -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize parameter if you don't have access to our NodePanel.

If you have either a Java heap space or GC overhead limit exceeded error, you'll need to increase the "Maximum Ram" field in your Java Settings. This is the -Xmx parameter typically.
